name: Extract b0 images from DWI
summary: Splits a DWI into its b=0 volumes and its diffusion-weighted volumes with MRtrix3 dwiextract, outputting each as a separate DWI with matching bvals and bvecs.
description: Runs MRtrix3 dwiextract with -bzero and with -no_bzero to write two DWI datasets with exported FSL gradient files. Use it when a downstream App needs only the b0 volumes (for example for registration or distortion correction) or only the diffusion-weighted volumes. Needs a DWI with bvals and bvecs that contains b=0 volumes. Utility App.

inputs.description: Diffusion-weighted image with bvecs and bvals.

outputs.description: DWI containing only the diffusion-weighted (non-b0) volumes, with matching bvals and bvecs.
DWI containing only the b=0 volumes, with matching bvals and bvecs.

failure_modes.cause: dwi/dwi.nii.gz was not produced by dwiextract.
failure_modes.fix: Check that bvals/bvecs match the DWI and, for shell extraction, that the requested shell exists.
